In case anyone has missed these emails going around, here are some upcoming workshops that might be of interest to D-RUG folk:

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Duncan Temple Lang <dtemp...@ucdavis.edu>
Date: Wed, Sep 2, 2015 at 8:16 AM
Subject: [datascience-announce] Fwd: Three workshop announcements: iPlant multi workshop; microbial genomics; UCSC Genome Browser
To: datascienc...@ucdavis.edu


3 workshops from Titus Brown's group that might be of interest.


-------- Forwarded Message --------
Subject: Three workshop announcements: iPlant multi workshop; microbial genomics; UCSC Genome Browser
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2015 07:25:31 -0700
From: C. Titus Brown <ctb...@ucdavis.edu>
Reply-To: ti...@idyll.org
To: dib-tr...@lists.idyll.org
CC: Duncan Temple Lang <dtemp...@ucdavis.edu>, Monica Britton <mtbr...@ucdavis.edu>

Hi all,

I am pleased to announce three new workshops offered through (and/or in collaboration with) my lab’s training program:

Sep 21-23, 2015 - iPlant Collaborative multiworkshop (free). See http://dib-training.readthedocs.org/en/pub/2015-09-iplant.html.

Sep 24-25, 2015 - Microbial genomics and transcriptomics (free). See http://dib-training.readthedocs.org/en/pub/2015-09-24-microbes.html.

Dec 7-8, 2015 - UCSC Genome Browser workshop ($75). See http://training.bioinformatics.ucdavis.edu/2015/07/14/ucsc-genome-browser-workshop-december-7-8-2015/.  Offered in conjunction with the Genome Center!

Please see http://dib-training.readthedocs.org/en/pub/ for other upcoming and planned workshops!

—titus
